Bug_Details: If the finalize() is implemented, it should do something besides just calling super.finalize(). Note that Oracle has declared Object.finalize() as deprecated since JDK 9.
Bug_Explanation: The finalize() method is implemented, but it only calls the super.finalize() method without doing anything else. This violates the bug rule 'FinalizeOnlyCallsSuperFinalize' which states that if the finalize() method is implemented, it should do something besides just calling super.finalize().
